purpose: Compare a separately trained compact tile-face classifier with pretrained detectors; do not equate crop accuracy with live full-hand recognition.
architecture: torchvision MobileNetV3 Small; 34 ordinary tile classes plus background rejection
initialization: Official ImageNet weights, SHA256 047dcff4addef86ea5bc2eff13c9614dc11f47ab1160d0a71a25e7db994f4e1f; no Mahjong-finetuned weights
dataset: Pinned RF100-VL Mahjong v2 mirror; source metadata/license audit stored separately
split: Original images plus transitive detected duplicate groups; original train exposures never become held-out tests; unknown physical/session identity remains unknown
selection: Highest development macro recall among present classes; development accuracy tie-break. Freeze chosen checkpoint before internal-test evaluation.
augmentation: Small rotations, optional 180-degree turn, scale, shear, brightness, contrast, color and mild blur; no mirrored Chinese characters
test_access: Do not open protected test pixels during crop preparation or training. Generate/evaluate protected crops only after checkpoint selection is recorded.
reporting: Classification accuracy and confusion with supplied ground-truth boxes
All annotated ordinary crops correct per original source, explicitly not whole-hand detection accuracy
Predeclared confidence thresholds 0.50/0.70/0.80/0.90/0.95/0.99 reported descriptively, not selected using test results
Development-only full detector plus classifier experiment on the old Commons development set
No unseen physical tile-set claim without source evidence
Report negative results and do not replace app baseline on model-selection scores alone
